newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 1.93 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 1.93 mln lbs frozen pork for programs.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought approximately 1.93 million lbs of pork products for use in the National School Lunch Program and other Federal programs.
The latest award under Announcement LS-50, Invitation 25 and 26 will be shipped between January 13 and 26, 1997.
Details of the purchase are as follows:
Total purchases since the program was announced:
Winning bidders for the course ground pork were American Foods Group (Huron, SD) 475,200 lbs and Bo Packing Company (Chicago IL) 198,000 lbs.

Winning bidders for the frozen hams were American Foods Group (Mitchell, SD) 72,000 lbs, Clougherty Packing Co (Los Angeles) 108,000 lbs, Dietz and Watson (Philadelphia) 108,000 lbs, Excel Corp (Fort Branch, Ind) 288,000, and Farmland Foods (Albert Lea, Minn) 684,000 lbs.
